shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Floating overlays (popovers, dialogs, sheets) in dark mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action on the dark ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.922 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); border: none; border-radius: 0.4375rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.85 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting surface on the void ground; flat, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 0.4375rem; padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.708 0 0); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field on the dark ground.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); border-radius: 0.4375rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; width: 100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.556 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0 0 / 40%); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Eligibility/state signal; colour is the only decoration.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; background: oklch(0.269 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border-radius: 0.7875rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge--ok { color: oklch(0.76 0.17 155); }

narrative.overview: A dark, dense, instrument-like surface — neutral greys, monospace numerals, tight radii. It reads like a Bloomberg terminal for job hunting: every pixel earns its place, and decoration is absent. The aesthetic is precise, quiet, and utilitarian; the ground is pure black and the only colour is the status palette signalling eligibility.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground with stepped neutral surfaces for depth.
Geist Sans for text, Geist Mono for numbers, dates, deadlines and scores.
Tight radii (base 0.4375rem) and neutral greys; no accent colour.
Status colours (emerald/sky/amber/red) are the only colour and only signal state.
No shadows in dark mode; depth via tonal layering.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Status colours are the only colour in the UI; they appear only to signal state, never as decoration or brand.

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: All counts, scores, dates and deadlines use Geist Mono with tabular-nums; never proportionally spaced numerals.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) or on floating overlays.

dos: Do use Geist Sans for text and Geist Mono for numbers, dates, deadlines and scores.
Do keep the ground pure black and surfaces stepped in neutral OKLCH.
Do use status colours only to signal eligibility/state.
Do use focus-visible rings instead of outlines.
Do use tabular-nums on every numeric readout.
donts: Don't introduce an accent colour, tinted ground, or custom palette.
Don't change typefaces, colour token values, or radii.
Don't use glassmorphism/backdrop-blur as a default surface treatment.
Don't use transition: all; list properties explicitly.
Don't treat a region restriction as a hard no.
